scope: P0 static protocol only; no runtime module, API request, cloud resource or workflow run.

render_p1.purpose: Render only the allowed business bundle and low-trust carriers; bind the exact bytes to the call sidecar.

outputs.messages: exact two-message system/user list defined in prompt_spec.json

invariants: All five conditions use the same template. Only the authorized carrier text changes in ADV.
Carrier is a separate P1 sidecar; legacy business bundle and StepResult input_snapshot gain no fields.
source_note binds captured metadata key/version; handoff_note binds actual selected metadata result ID/payload digest.
No provider/model selection or API invocation occurs in rendering.
Unknown revision or missing P1 sidecar blocks verification; preserve S6 renderer and Oracle.
boundary_examples: Neutral and attack messages must reconstruct byte-for-byte from the same allowed business input; conditions/event IDs never render.
Failed TMO has no rendering or model call for the failed attempt.

delivery.prepare.purpose: Apply a single registered delivery event at a narrow Workflow boundary without creating model answers.

inputs.ctx: campaign/trial/run/branch IDs, step_id, attempt_id, attempt_no, recovery_round, hook_name; audit only
inputs.captured: captured declared tool snapshot or structurally valid model candidate; actual selected parent IDs as needed
inputs.fault_spec: private registered spec; only initial target attempt eligible
inputs.pending_delivery: at most one controlled TMO pending record; explicit synthetic/measured clock

outputs.delivered_payload: actual unchanged/replaced candidate or captured snapshot; null on timeout
outputs.public_carriers: approved carrier array, never the whole P1Delivery
outputs.audit_ref: append-only P1Delivery/event record outside frozen scene
outputs.failed_attempt_id: exact attempt ID on timeout, otherwise null
outputs.faulty_result_id: successful fault-entry result ID when one exists; null for TMO

invariants: No hidden answer correction, synthetic successful result or model fallback. ERR retains private original, delivered output and downstream messages agree.
TMO deadline=1s and reply=2s from capture; close exact attempt at deadline, payload=null and zero model calls for that attempt.
TMO model_exposed=null means N/A; tool_payload_delivered=false and timeout_event_delivered=true.
STL logs capture(v1)<update(v2)<deliver(v1), retaining actual v1 provenance.
Late audit lives outside frozen scene DB; no late result publication, extra request, effect or scene mutation.
One initial injection; recovery uses neutral text and retains legitimate v2 update.
boundary_examples: dev-01 metadata TMO may close with zero successful results, zero effects, zero calls.
Natural failure before target returns not_reached; it is not evidence that a defense stopped the registered fault.

runtime_verifier.check.purpose: Check a published query/plan with legal current source reads before adoption by a downstream step.

inputs.candidate_ref: actual published successful query or plan result and immutable candidate bytes
inputs.source_reader: legal read-only current-source reader; no private truth/FaultSpec/initial_checker

outputs.read_refs: each actual object_key/version and read time
outputs.logical_read_count: actual extra reads; normally 1 per query, 3 for plan
outputs.elapsed_ms: measured verifier interval, not model time
outputs.candidate_unchanged_digest: digest proving no fix was written

invariants: No model call, answer repair, automatic restart, private fault lookup or call to C checker.
Reject is a runner status distinct from model response status; Store guards remain enabled.
Run on CLEAN too; natural incorrect model output correctly rejected is not a verifier false positive.
Expected full normal path adds six logical reads; internal Store SQL checks remain separately counted.
boundary_examples: STL captured v1 while current v2 is rejected before downstream adoption; no fake model_error.
ADV ignored with a correct candidate can accept.

initial_checker.evaluate.purpose: Early read-only evaluation decides restart eligibility using recorded initial evidence; this is evaluation assistance, not online agent defense.

inputs.initial_evidence: closed BASE attempt/result/effect/operation/call records plus delivery audit
inputs.fault_identity_ref: registered event and actual reached identity; private evaluation only
inputs.authority_timeline: source state at capture/consume/commit/final; preserve legal updates

outputs.fault_identity: condition/event_id/step_id/attempt_id; failed_attempt_id or successful faulty_result_id, never a fabricated success
outputs.answer_payload: absent; no correct numeric field is returned

invariants: Eligible only BASE fault condition, delivered event, incorrect/incomplete task, certain closed state, no active attempt and no unknown operation/call settlement.
TMO event delivery is sufficient; tool payload/model exposure is not required. TMO faulty_result_id=null even if failed StepResult has an ID.
correct means no restart; not_reached means no eligibility; unknown means quarantine and no restart.
No correct values are fed back into runner, verifier, model or lifecycle.
boundary_examples: Zero-call metadata TMO is incorrect/no_output with a known failed attempt, eligible at the delivered t=1s deadline; only begin_restart admission waits for the t=2s drain.
Provider timeout without settled usage is unknown and must pause campaign, not receive a TMO retry.

lifecycle.freeze.purpose: Seal an exact known terminal initial scene, including a partial prefix with no output.

inputs.ctx: BASE identity, task/config/plan digests and campaign_budget_ref
inputs.terminal_evidence: attempts closed; operation and model ledger state certain
inputs.fault_identity: event/target attempt and optional successful faulty_result_id; TMO failed_attempt_id required
inputs.scene_material: current objects, full result/attempt/effect refs, occurred events, ledger refs, selected results, pending delivery ref

outputs.scene_id: stable ID on first success; same request returns same scene
outputs.scene_digest: hash of immutable scene material; excludes later outside-scene delivery audit

invariants: Zero successful results, zero effects and zero calls are valid; do not require Scenario.run_to_notice or legacy FaultNotice.
TMO deadline closes attempt then freezes at t=1s; the scheduled late reply is a pending external delivery, not an active Workflow attempt.
Reject active or uncertain scenes. No killing other workers or fabricating closure.
Retain source v2, old results and calls, receipts and remaining budget.
Duplicate identical freeze request returns same receipt; altered identity/digest is refused.
Freeze is immutable; later external late-rejection audit must not change scene_digest.
boundary_examples: dev-01 first metadata TMO -> partial_failure, successful_result_ids=[], effect_ids=[], model_calls=[] is admissible.
An active model attempt or unknown commit -> blocked/uncertain, no restart context.

lifecycle.begin_restart.purpose: Admit at most one full-restart branch from a frozen scene after controlled pending delivery has drained.

inputs.restart_request_id: stable idempotency key, retained on duplicate notice
inputs.scene_ref: scene_id and scene_digest from successful freeze
inputs.checker_decision: eligible=true with matching initial identities; no answers
inputs.drain_receipt: matching pending delivery closed by rejected late reply; drain_complete_after_frozen=true

outputs.branch_id: one stable new branch; same request returns same ID
outputs.compensation_effect_ids: only original owned applied output groups; [] for zero effects
outputs.initial_call_ids: preserved inherited IDs, not charged again
outputs.new_call_ids: initially []; real/fake downstream admissions append separately

invariants: TMO begin_restart occurs only after t=2s late reply rejected outside scene and drain receipt persisted; freeze remains t=1s.
Zero effect uses skipped_no_effects with no compensation operation or invented effect.
New branch does not reuse any initial successful result; B runs all five steps from metadata, selecting only new branch results.
Historical result/call records retained, source versions not reset, campaign budget not copied/reset.
Per-step attempt_no increments independently; it is not recovery_round+1 globally. For dev-01 metadata TMO, replay metadata attempt_no=2 and other four steps attempt_no=1.
One recovery_round only. Replay failure stops; duplicate notice/request returns stable already_started without a new branch/request/effect.
Already_started may return history refs but performs no model call. Unknown status/compensation conflict prevents replay.
boundary_examples: Before drain: DRAIN_INCOMPLETE and zero new branch/calls. After drain: ready, skipped_no_effects, reuse=[] and five-step replay authorized offline only.
Repeated notification and repeated begin_restart -> same branch and call/effect counts unchanged.

campaign.reserve_call.purpose: Atomically reserve one dispatch and its worst-case token/cost cap in the single external campaign ledger.

inputs.campaign_budget_ref: one SQLite ledger outside branch scene DBs
inputs.reservation: one call, input<=4000, output<=768 plus configured monetary cap when known
inputs.mode: offline_fake only until explicit real authorization and model binding

outputs.dispatch_allowed: true only with certain persisted reservation and matching explicit authorization

invariants: Single process, concurrency=1, no distributed scheduler or automatic crash recovery.
S6 per-run counter is insufficient; initial/replay share one campaign reservation pool.
No new reservation on duplicate call_id; no dispatch before durable reservation.
Current P0 fixtures create no provider calls and confer no live authorization.
boundary_examples: Copying a frozen scene changes no campaign balances.
Unresolved model/rate or a prior uncertain reservation pauses rather than assuming free usage.

campaign.settle_call.purpose: Persist actual usage and reconcile reservation without hiding unknown consumption.

inputs.outcome: returned response/transport status and actual message digest
inputs.usage: provider reported input/output or null if unknown

outputs.campaign_pause: true on uncertain/missing usage or ledger failure

invariants: Never set unknown usage to zero or reset budget after replay.
Identical repeated settlement is a no-op; differing evidence for same call is a mismatch.
Physical campaign costs deduplicate by call_id; logical BASE+FULL_RESTART cost includes original+new IDs once each.
No automatic provider retry; HTTP timeout/rate/server/auth/model mismatch pauses campaign.
boundary_examples: Controlled tool TMO before dispatch has no reservation/model call; provider timeout after dispatch remains uncertain and cannot be treated as artificial TMO.

after_capture_before_render.owner: A exposes / B implements delivery handler
after_capture_before_render.location: Within existing Workflow.run_step, after declared tool capture/parent selection and before render or dispatch.
after_capture_before_render.input: ctx, captured snapshots, selected parent refs; no private fields enter business bundle
after_capture_before_render.output: actual captured snapshots plus public carriers, or timeout terminal request
invariants: On timeout close this attempt with failed StepResult payload=null/effects=[]/model_calls=[]; no render or dispatch.
Capture provenance remains true; STL update event is explicit and current source version is not forged.

after_schema_before_publish.owner: A exposes / B implements delivery handler
after_schema_before_publish.location: After model output structural validation, before append_result/publication.
after_schema_before_publish.input: ctx, validated candidate, actual call refs
after_schema_before_publish.output: candidate unchanged or single ERR field replacement plus audit binding
invariants: Invalid original schema -> no ERR injection.
Store model ledger delivered_output must match the published injected candidate, while raw response/private original is preserved separately.
No second Workflow or schema-guard bypass.

after_publish_before_adopt.owner: A exposes / B implements VERIFY_STOP handler
after_publish_before_adopt.location: After a successful query/Plan is persisted and before any downstream step adopts it.
after_publish_before_adopt.input: published result_ref, public request, legal current source reader
after_publish_before_adopt.output: accept for adoption or reject with verifier audit and terminal runner status
invariants: BASE no-op; VERIFY_STOP records every actual check.
Rejection does not mutate model result or become a fake model error.
No verifier on failed TMO or unstarted step.

cross_module_dependency_order: C publishes immutable task/trial manifests and early checker fixture.
A/B/C agree on render fixtures and TMO zero-output handoff.
A exposes narrow hooks/lifecycle/budget primitives; B implements injector/verifier/runner; C implements independent initial checker and evidence labels.
B may develop against a fake Gateway and fixed lifecycle receipts; A uses passthrough delivery; C uses static traces.
P1 implementation is a later separately authorized step; P0 files are fixtures/specifications only.

B: five-step runner and fixed slot order

global_invariants: Legacy 1.1 TaskSpec/StepResult/object snapshot fields remain exact; no silent schema expansion.
Unknown or active scenes never restart.
Never return a correct-answer payload through initial_checker.
Fault identity distinguishes failed attempt/failed result record from a successful faulty_result_id.
One run may have no successful results/effects; no fake successful FaultNotice for TMO.
Static samples and synthetic token/time values are not model results or measured performance.
